# Domain X-Ray · 1ms.dog

> DNS records for any domain, looked up from the visitor's browser over DNS over HTTPS: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS,
> TXT, CAA, SRV and SOA at 12 public resolvers at once, merged by value, with each resolver's own answer under
> Resolver answers. From that the page gives a checkup grade: how far the resolvers agree, how the mail setup looks
> (SPF, DMARC), and whether DNSSEC validates. It also compares the registrar's name servers (RDAP) with the ones the
> resolvers return, and shows registration data (registrar, dates, status). DNS queries never pass through 1ms.dog's
> servers; registration data does when the browser cannot read the registry itself, and the page marks those answers.
> Nothing is stored beyond a one-hour lookup cache, and no account is needed.

- Page: https://dig.1ms.dog/ (also /zh-cn/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, /ru/)
- Source code: https://github.com/yt1988/dns-records
- Uses RDAP through rdap.org: https://rdap.org/
- Resolvers: Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, Control D, DNS.SB, CleanBrowsing, Rethink DNS, DNS4EU, CZ.NIC ODVR,
  DNSForge, Tiarap, IIJ
